name: Suggest a resource or exercise
about: Propose a free resource, lab, course or exercise for a phase of the roadmap

---

**What are you suggesting (name and link, no tracking parameters)**

**Which phase, and which checkpoint item or exercise it improves**

**Have you used it yourself? One sentence on what you did with it**

**Is it free**

- [ ] Completely free
- [ ] Free tier that covers the exercise it supports
- [ ] Paid (please do not submit paid-only courses)

**What gap does it fill that the current resources do not**

**Checks**

- [ ] The link loads for me today
- [ ] I am not affiliated with it, or I have said so above
- [ ] No statistics, prices or outcome claims unless I linked the source
- [ ] Not a paid-only course, referral link or affiliate link
